interpretation: The 286 source observations requiring identity/variant review are not necessarily 286 new customs. Some will fold into existing customs, stay regional variants, belong to liturgy/saints/prayers or remain unverified.
review_policy: Adjudicate actual practice identity before searching for additional pictures or building interface.
For each item decide: existing canonical custom, same-practice variant, related-but-distinct custom, regional history only, another app owner, or exclude/hold.
Retain independent documentary citations and exact local dates; a calendar date does not make a local event universal.
Do not assign canonical IDs or publish from this queue until owner review and source closure.

review_batches.description: Reconcile already covered Mass, Calendar, Pray, Saints and rites to prevent duplicate customs; no new identity implied.
Adjudicate unlinked candidate, enrichment and regional observations against the 42 working identities and 14 same-practice/28 related-family groups.
Specific P1 independent-evidence gaps; 38 no exact matches plus 46 partial/indirect holds. This is a subset of the 568 observations, not additive.
Keep 117 history-only locators and 34 exclusions searchable in research, not live customs.
Subset of B2: editorial decisions already assign these to other module content, regional reference or ritual/source hold. Do not mint new customs.
Subset of B2: no explicit 54-card editorial owner reconciliation yet. These 260 observations are the next identity/variant pass; many will resolve without creating a custom.
All 260 have a provisional editorial route in three chapter files. Documentary source closure, identity deduplication and Calendar acceptance remain OPEN.
